# Memories of a Travel Addict Chick

> > A personal travel blog documenting adventures across Europe, Asia, Africa, and island destinations with detailed guides, cultural experiences, and gluten-free dining tips.

This travel blog focuses on off-the-beaten-path experiences and practical guides for destinations including the Canary Islands (Tenerife, Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria), Budapest, India, Bulgaria, Greece, and more. The author shares detailed itineraries, hiking adventures, cultural insights, and specialized resources for celiac travelers seeking gluten-free dining options.

## Key Topics

- Canary Islands
- Budapest
- Gluten-free dining
- Island hopping
- Spain travel
- Tenerife & Teide volcano
- Historical sites
- Mountain hiking
- Cultural experiences
- Volcanic landscapes
- India travel
- Bulgaria
- Greece
- Travel tips
- Off-the-beaten-path destinations

## Budapest & Central Europe

- [23 Unusual Places in Budapest That Tourists Often Miss](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2025/10/17/23-unusual-places-in-budapest-that-tourists-often-miss): Hidden Budapest gems: Hospital in the Rock, Memento Park, ruin bars & more
- [Budapest – A Gluten-free Heaven 2.](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2024/02/20/budapest-a-gluten-free-heaven-2): Guide to 280+ Budapest restaurants with gluten-free options using Find me GF
- [Advent in Graz](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2019/12/28/advent-in-graz): Graz Christmas markets guide: Austrian advent traditions & attractions

## Canary Islands Guides

- [The Canary Islands Guide](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2019/05/22/the-canary-islands-guide): Complete guide to all Canary Islands: Tenerife, Lanzarote, Gran Canaria & more
- [Fuerteventura Guide, Canary islands](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/02/17/fuerteventura-guide-canary-islands): Fuerteventura guide: Corralejo Dunes, Cofete Beach, Ajuy & volcanic landscapes
- [The Teleferico to the Teide in Tenerife](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/01/02/the-teleferico-to-the-teide-in-tenerife): Teide cable car guide: Pico del Teide volcano & hiking in Tenerife
- [Walking on the top of the White Crater (Caldera Blanca) in Lanzarote](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2017/02/20/walking-on-the-top-of-the-white-crater-caldera-blanca-in-lanzarote): Caldera Blanca hiking guide near Timanfaya Natural Park, Lanzarote

## Spain & Mediterranean Islands

- [Excursions in SICILY](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/12/20/excursions-in-sicily): Sicily excursions: Agrigento, Etna volcano, Aeolian Islands & Godfather tour
- [A Day in Palma de Mallorca](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/09/28/a-day-in-palma-de-mallorca): One-day Palma guide: La Seu Cathedral, castle & Jardines de s'Hort del Rei
- [The Local Market in Sineu, Mallorca](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/05/29/the-local-market-in-sineu-mallorca): Authentic Wednesday market in Sineu, Mallorca with local food & crafts
- [Rhodes – Butterfly valley, Seven Springs, Filerimos Monastery & Monolithos Castle](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/02/13/rhodes-butterfly-valley-seven-springs-filerimos-monastery-monolithos-castle): Rhodes attractions: Petaloudes valley, Seven Springs, monasteries & castles

## India Cultural Experiences

- [Death on the Ganges – Varanasi, India](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/11/23/death-on-the-ganges-varanasi-india): Varanasi spiritual experience: Ganges cremation ghats & boat ride rituals
- [Bishnoi Village Safari from Jodhpur, India](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/03/12/bishnoi-village-safari-from-jodhpur-india): Cultural tour to Bishnoi village community from Jodhpur, Rajasthan

## Eastern Europe & Balkans

- [Hiking the Seven Rila Lakes – a crazy drive from Sunny Beach, Bulgaria](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2017/08/05/hiking-the-seven-rila-lakes-a-crazy-drive-from-sunny-beach-bulgaria): Day trip from Sunny Beach to hike Seven Rila Lakes in Bulgaria mountains
- [Discovering Veliko Tarnovo in Bulgaria](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2017/09/09/discovering-veliko-tarnovo-in-bulgaria): Veliko Tarnovo: Bulgaria's City of Tsars with Tsaravets Fortress & Arbanasi

## Africa & Caribbean Adventures

- [Samana: A Whale Watcher's Paradise in the Dominican Republic](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2019/05/10/whale-watching-in-samana-dominican-republic): Humpback whale watching in Samaná Bay, Dominican Republic (Jan-Mar season)
- [Excursion to Mombasa in Kenya](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/10/18/excursion-to-mombasa-in-kenya): Mombasa tour: Fort Jesus, Old Town, markets & iconic Elephant Tusks
- [One Day in the Sahara in Egypt](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2018/01/17/one-day-in-the-sahara-in-egypt): Sahara desert tour in Egypt: Badawya excursion, camel rides & quad buggy

## Travel Resources & Tips

- [Airport Survival Guide – Tips and Tricks](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2025/02/19/airport-survival-guide-tips-and-tricks): Airport survival tips: check-in, documents, Apple Wallet & travel preparation
- [Finding the TreeTop Walk at the MacRitchie Reservoir in Singapore](https://memoriesofatraveladdictchick.wordpress.com/2017/06/20/finding-the-treetop-walk-at-the-macritchie-reservoir-in-singapore): TreeTop Walk suspension bridge at MacRitchie Reservoir nature reserve
